proposed_from.topic: Cycle-rank efficiency frontier for proportional staggered difference-in-differences. In a fixed-T staggered panel with independent units, arbitrary within-unit dependence and finite fourth moments, impose no anticipation and a positive connected multiplicative rank-one untreated-mean array mu_gt=a_g b_t. Target Moreau-Kastler's proportional treatment on the treated, theta_PTT=A/B-1. On the untreated cohort-time bipartite graph H_U let q=|U|-|C_U|-|T_U|+1. Prove that weighted alternating even-cycle vectors span the complete tangent restriction space, derive the canonical gradient and an attaining feasible covariance-weighted estimator, and differentiate the published PPML-imputation estimator. The hard theorem is topology-level: PPML imputation is efficient for every legal bounded nonnegative-outcome covariance law iff q=0. If q>0, show the universally efficient covariances satisfy exactly q independent primitive alternating balance equations, form a proper lower-dimensional subset, and construct an open realizable covariance family on which the exact loss Gamma=b'(R'Omega R)^(-1)b is strictly positive, with the sharp quadratic/spectral characterization and pointwise Wald inference. Keep the banked population PPML forbidden-comparison theorem and routine sandwich theory out of scope. Consumers are the Nagengast--Yotov regional-trade-agreement and Menkhoff--Miethe treaty/bank-deposit PPML applications. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived the weighted-cycle nullspace, bounded-score tangent construction, explicit PPML coefficient, canonical gradient, and exact loss. For every cycle it perturbed Cov(Y_gt,Y_gg), obtaining a diagonal balance response -1/(B mu_gt); a positive fixed-support Rademacher density realizes the full q-dimensional covariance family while keeping means and variances fixed, so the loss is an explicit positive-definite quadratic form. Exact rational calculation reproduced the legal 3x3 witness: theta=.5, V*=.06333936, PPML variance=.06506836, and Gamma=.00172900. All 56 staggered supports through T=6 passed independent cycle-basis/response checks. Singular covariances, zero means, absent never-treated support, unrealizable perturbations, generic-GMM collapse, and the additive PT-All quotient collision were checked and excluded or placed outside scope. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the general finite-fourth-moment tangent lower bound with an explicit differentiable-mean submodel convention and justify score-moment differentiation while preserving the bounded-law topology construction. EARLY KILL TEST: Reconstruct every canonical cycle and covariance-response matrix through T=6, verifying the diagonal -1/(B mu_gt) response, unchanged cycle Gram, and exact fixed-support covariances; any failure stops the topology converse. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest result sets are Moreau--Kastler (2025), whose equations 3.13--3.14 aggregate counterfactuals from an untreated individual fixed-effects PPML fit, Wooldridge (2023), whose fully interacted individual-level nonlinear specification targets cohort--time average treatment effects, and Chen, Sant'Anna, and Xie (2025), which derives additive staggered-DiD efficient influence functions. The comparator studied here is deliberately narrower and different: a cohort-mean rank-one PPML-imputation estimator, with exact equivalence to Moreau--Kastler confined to the stated no-covariate, equal-weight aggregation boundary. Király, Theran, and Tomioka (2015) supply cycle algebra but no statistical tangent space. The precise delta is an if-and-only-if universal-efficiency theorem for the cohort-mean estimator: efficiency for every bounded legal covariance law holds exactly at cycle rank zero; at positive cycle rank, exactly \(q\) independent primitive covariance balances characterize the exceptional laws, and a support-preserving family realizes a positive-definite exact quadratic loss.

seed_details.seed: Cycle-rank if-and-only-if efficiency frontier for proportional PPML imputation
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Section 3.2.2, equations 3.13--3.14; printed page 21; Conclusion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The anchor's argument ends with probability convergence of the imputed numerator and denominator. The first new step is to differentiate that ratio jointly with the rank-one untreated mean manifold and identify every orthogonal tangent direction.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for proportional PTT with semiparametric efficiency, PPML with graph cycle rank, and multiplicative staggered DiD with canonical gradients found no exact target--method match; ChenSantAnnaXie2025 is additive and KiralyTheranTomioka2015 is noncausal matrix completion.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from generic optimal generalized method of moments because cycles merely count overidentifying restrictions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic projection does not prove that every staggered cycle is PTT-relevant, that the covariance map has rank exactly \(q\), or that a bounded nonnegative law realizes a full strict-loss neighborhood.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The kernel is an if-and-only-if theorem plus a generic-region realizability result, not a single covariance witness or a relabeled projection identity.

seed_details.seed: Finite-fourth-moment tangent bound and feasible canonical-gradient attainment for PTT
seed_details.anchor_locator: Section 3.2.2, equations 3.13--3.14 and the unit-bootstrap sentence on printed page 21.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed proof step replaces consistency of a ratio with density of support-preserving scores whose mean derivatives lie in the rank-one Jacobian column space.
seed_details.destination_search: Newey1990 and Chamberlain1987 give abstract score projection, while ChenSantAnnaXie2025 derives additive DiD efficient influence functions; none treats nonnegative rank-one PTT with arbitrary within-unit covariance.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A smooth finite-dimensional mean restriction makes the efficient influence function a textbook formula.
seed_details.rebuttal: The formula is routine, but tangent completeness under nonnegative support and only finite fourth moments, plus an attaining feasible estimator for the nonlinear PTT ratio, is not supplied by the textbook formula.
seed_details.selection: survived and integrated into chosen kernel
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposal isolates the nonroutine score-density step and does not sell the projection formula alone.

seed_details.seed: Dyadic exchangeable extension of the proportional cycle frontier
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction and empirical Sections 5.1--5.2 on bilateral trade and bank deposits; Conclusion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first invalid step is the independent-strata direct-sum tangent space. It must be replaced by an Aldous--Hoover or Hoeffding projection that tracks exporter and importer components before cycle projection.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing dyadic exchangeable efficiency with proportional staggered PPML found generic multiway-cluster limit theory but no PTT canonical gradient or cycle frontier.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Generic multiway-cluster theory mechanically replaces the independent covariance matrix.
seed_details.rebuttal: Degenerate dyadic projections can change the rate and limit law, so the canonical gradient and the necessity of \(q=0\) are not obtained by a covariance substitution.
seed_details.selection: survived literature scan but not chosen because the independent-unit kernel is substantially more feasible
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed identifies the first broken proof step and a dependence-driven limit object rather than appending clustered standard errors.

seed_details.seed: Growing-cycle-rank spectral limit law for covariance-corrected proportional DiD
seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem 34, Remark 35, Algorithm 6, and Section 8 Discussion and Outlook.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The fixed-dimensional inversion of \(K=R^{\prime}\Omega R\) is the first changed step; growing \(q\) requires spectral regularization and a joint limit for estimated cycle residuals.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for growing cycle rank with PPML DiD and spectral regularization found matrix-completion error work but no proportional causal ratio limit law.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is a routine high-dimensional generalized-method-of-moments extension.
seed_details.rebuttal: The spectrum is constrained by a weighted graph cycle Gram matrix and estimated rank-one means, so admissible regularization and the phase transition are topology-specific.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The focal object is the cycle-Gram spectral regime, not a generic growing-parameter slogan.

seed_details.seed: Critical multiplicative-trend violation for PTT sign and estimator ranking
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Section 3.2.2 on multiplicative imputation; Conclusion.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Replace exact rank-one means by bounded log-cycle violations and first derive how the PTT identified set and the PPML-versus-efficient ranking vary with the violation radius.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for multiplicative staggered-DiD sensitivity with a critical violation radius found additive parallel-trend sensitivity but no closed-form cycle-based PTT threshold.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Log-cycle residual bounds are an immediate multiplicative rewrite of additive trend sensitivity.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target is a ratio whose denominator is jointly completed across cycles, so the sharp critical radius and covariance-aware ranking do not follow from additive bounds.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A publishable version must derive closed-form endpoints and a named critical radius; qualitative robustness alone is rejected.

seed_details.seed: Minimax PTT estimation when the number of untreated cycles grows
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorems 1--2 and their proofs; Conclusion and Appendix A.7.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The anchor's fixed-horizon linear-imputation weights become an estimated nonlinear cycle correction; the first changed step is controlling the inverse cycle Gram matrix while constructing a matching local alternative.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for minimax rates of staggered proportional DiD with growing pretreatment dimension found no direct match.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The rate is determined immediately by the smallest eigenvalue of a growing information matrix.
seed_details.rebuttal: A matching converse must respect nonnegative support, staggered observation geometry, and the nonlinear denominator rather than perturb an unrestricted Gaussian sequence.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed requires both a legal estimator and a topology-respecting converse; it is not another fixed-dimensional efficiency restatement.

seed_details.seed: Finite-sample permutation inversion of weighted log-cycle residuals
seed_details.proof_boundary: The anchor's randomization group acts on assigned adoption times, whereas observational proportional DiD has no known assignment symmetry. The first changed step is to identify a valid block-exchangeability orbit for untreated cycle residuals.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing conformal or permutation inference with multiplicative staggered PPML found no exact result, but the absence of a known assignment law sharply limits scope.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Without randomized timing, the permutation distribution is invalid.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed survives only for explicitly block-exchangeable or randomized-timing designs, where the orbit is a substantive additional design object rather than a placebo heuristic.
seed_details.selection: credible only in a narrower randomized-timing model and not shortlisted
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The restriction to a known symmetry group is explicit; no finite-sample validity is claimed for the observational benchmark.

seed_details.seed: Proportional treatment-policy regret from staggered imputed counterfactual means
seed_details.proof_boundary: The scalar PTT aggregation must be replaced first by a policy-indexed ratio value and an orthogonal covariance-weighted score before empirical welfare maximization can be analyzed.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for policy learning from multiplicative staggered DiD identified no direct target--method paper, but existing policy-learning theory makes the novelty depend on a genuinely ratio-specific regret geometry.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This merely feeds an estimated PTT into standard empirical welfare maximization.
seed_details.rebuttal: A viable theorem would need a policy-indexed counterfactual denominator, ratio-orthogonal scores, and regret controlled under cycle-dependent estimation error; without those it would be dropped.
seed_details.selection: credible research direction but not shortlisted
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is not selected because the current evidence supports a fixed-estimand efficiency theorem more directly than a policy objective.

proposed_from.literature_map: Moreau--Kastler (2025, Introduction and Section 3.2.2) defines PTT as the percentage change of the treated mean, gives the imputation ratio in equations 3.13--3.14, and recommends a unit panel bootstrap on printed page 21; no tangent-space or efficiency result is present. Ciani and Fisher (2019, Section 2 and Appendix C) establish the multiplicative DiD rationale and explicitly note that PPML need not be most efficient. Király, Theran, and Tomioka (2015, Theorem 34 and Remark 35) show that rank-one circuits are even cycles and become alternating linear equations after logs. Chamberlain (1987) and Newey (1990) provide the general covariance-projection and tangent-score tools. Roth and Sant'Anna (2023, Proposition 2.1) derive covariance-optimal additive staggered-rollout weights within a design-based estimator class. Borusyak, Jaravel, and Spiess (2024, Theorems 1--2) give the additive efficient-imputation template under their error model. Chen, Sant'Anna, and Xie (2025, Theorems 3.1--3.2 and Section 7) derive semiparametric efficient influence functions for additive DiD and name nonlinear DiD efficiency as an open extension. Wooldridge (1999) establishes distribution-free fixed-effects Poisson consistency and the role of additional moment information. Bounded searches for the exact phrases and pairings proportional PTT plus semiparametric efficiency, PPML plus graph cycle rank, and multiplicative staggered DiD plus canonical gradient found no paper subsuming the kernel. Nagengast and Yotov (2025) and Menkhoff and Miethe (2019) provide direct bilateral-flow consumers, while their shared-country dependence motivates a separate dyadic extension rather than entering the present theorem.
